description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LanguageDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Admin DAO module. It contains multiple test methods for verifying CRUD operations and lookup functionalities related to Language entities.

classes.name: LanguageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the LanguageDao's CRUD and lookup functionalities within the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of LanguageDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testAddLanguage
methods.description: Tests adding a new Language entity and verifies it is saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditLanguage
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Language entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Language entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple Language entities and verifies the number of deleted records.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Attempts to delete a non-existent Language record and verifies zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if different variations of the language name exist in the database.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language by its name with different casing and whitespace, verifying correctness, and also tests for a non-existing name.
